import sys

def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        n, k = map(int, parts)
        probabilities = list(map(float, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
        # Compute subset sums
        subset_sum = [0.0] * (1 << n)
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            total = 0.0
            for j in range(n):
                if mask & (1 << j):
                    total += probabilities[j]
            subset_sum[mask] = total

        active_count = sum(1 for p in probabilities if p > 1e-5)

        if active_count <= k:
            result = [1.0 if p > 1e-5 else 0.0 for p in probabilities]
            print(' '.join(map(str, result)))
            continue

        # Initialize DP array
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << n)
        dp[0] = 1.0

        for mask in range(1 << n):
            remaining_mask = (~mask) & ((1 << n) - 1)
            for i in range(n):
                if (remaining_mask & (1 << i)) and probabilities[i] > 1e-5:
                    denom = subset_sum[remaining_mask]
                    if denom > 1e-12:
                        dp[mask | (1 << i)] += dp[mask] * probabilities[i] / denom

        result = [0.0] * n
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            count_bits = bin(mask).count('1')
            if count_bits != k:
                continue
            for i in range(n):
                if mask & (1 << i):
                    result[i] += dp[mask]

        print(' '.join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
